description_en: Updates the business metadata for a column in a data map. This operation can only update the business description and custom attributes
description_zh: 更新数据地图数据表给定字段的业务元数据，当前仅支持更新字段的业务描述和自定义属性
name: UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata

parameters.help_en: The ID of the column. You can obtain this ID from the response of the `ListColumns` operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.help_zh:
字段ID，可参考ListColumns接口返回结果，
以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The business description of the column
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The custom attributes of the column, specified as key-value pairs. The key is the attribute identifier, and the value is an array that can contain at most one element. An empty array deletes the attribute's value. To avoid overwriting the column's business description, omit the `Description` parameter from the request. An empty object (`{}`) indicates that no custom attributes are updated
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value最多一个值；空列表表示删除该属性值。不传Description时传入本参数可避免清空字段业务描述；传空对象表示不更新自定义属性
parameters.name: custom_attributes

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
